subtitle: A former minor port turned working fishing village on the Bay of Bengal near Chirala, and Hyderabad's closest weekend beach.
spike_statement: In October 2025, three VIT-Amaravati students drowned and two more went missing in one day at Vodarevu Beach, swept away by strong Bay of Bengal currents.

levers.photo_tone: Fishing boats and drying nets on wet gray-brown sand under flat coastal light, the Bay of Bengal a working sea rather than a postcard turquoise.
